240V × 100A = 24,000 VA. At unity power factor that is 24 kVA, so the smallest size listed that carries it is 25 kVA. (Theory 20.10)
240V × 100A = 24,000 VA. 24,000 ÷ 0.85 = 28,235 VA, about 28.24 kVA, so the smallest size listed that carries it is 37.50 kVA. (Theory 20.10)
